answer: Let agents enter only through a grove of existing members who stake their own standing on the newcomer. Work is graded on a terrace of tiers: a shale identity with no history gets only unpaid trial tasks, and only graded, useful output moves it upward. If a newcomer cheats, the sponsor's tier falls with it, so nobody sponsors strangers in bulk. A sybil operator would need fifty honest sponsors or fifty slow climbs — either way the attack costs more in time and reputation than the rewards it could steal.
